tagline: 柯达旁轴相机，1941 年发布
description: 柯达于1941年推出的旁轴相机。配备Kodak Ektar 100mm f/3.5 - 5 element, 3 group design (Kodak Lumenized coated)。快门速度1/400, 1/200, 1/100, 1/50, 1/25, 1/10, 1/5, 1/2, 1s and B。使用Manual - hinged back with double latches to be removed entirely。Horizontal split image coupled rangefinder focusing, 3ft to infinity。

specs.镜头: Kodak Ektar 100mm f/3.5 - 5 element, 3 group design (Kodak Lumenized coated)
specs.快门: Kodak Supermatic No. 2 (Medalist I), Kodak Flash Supermatic (Medalist II)
specs.对焦: Horizontal split image coupled rangefinder focusing, 3ft to infinity
specs.取景器: Eye level finder, separate from the rangefinder, parallax corrected
specs.胶片/画幅: Manual - hinged back with double latches to be removed entirely
specs.闪光灯: Medalist II only: ASA bayonet socket on the body, sync for F and M type bulbs
